name: Miku Maruyama
source: A short tomboy who seems supplied with endless energy, Miku is the star of the school's soccer team. Alas, her athletic talents do not extend to her schoolwork, where thankfully her roommate has the ability and patience to help her through with tutoring. She can be found on the soccer field on weekend mornings.
